question: What is the chief cause in knowledge transmission?
premises: The Lord declares most secret knowledge to the non-envious.
The knowledge is accompanied by realized knowledge.
Knowing it frees one from the inauspicious.
Non-enviousness is the chief cause in knowledge transmission.
This holds as before in knowledge and realization.
inference: Non-enviousness is the chief cause in the transmission of knowledge.
uncertainties: The compound jñānavijñāne-prāgvat is compressed; its exact referent to prior discussion is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: Now the ninth chapter. The blessed Lord said: I will declare to the non-envious this most secret knowledge together with realized knowledge; knowing it, you will be freed from the inauspicious. Non-enviousness is the chief cause in the transmission of knowledge, as before in knowledge and realization.
